analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: IR40a is an insect odorant receptor with no mammalian ortholog, so human cell lines lack the target and should show essentially no transcriptional response; the closest listed classes are other ionotropic/neuronal receptor modulators that also act on receptors these cells barely express.
